principles.RG01: Freeze one issuer, sector, period and information window.
principles.RG02: Use retained evidence and exact source hashes.
principles.RG03: Classify facts, calculations and analyst judgments separately.
principles.RG04: Require factual proof for reporting, sanctions and governance events.
principles.RG05: Use canonical rubric weights and bands.
principles.RG06: Prioritize detailed Method B when justified.
principles.RG07: Admit bounded Method A only within 3/3/2 ceilings.
principles.RG08: Verify native topics, minority protections and appropriate evidence.
principles.RG09: Separate governance profile from legal and reporting-reliability escalation.
principles.RG10: Preserve Stage 0 and Hard Veto as external formal controls.
principles.RG11: Record distinct loss channels and prior category ownership.
principles.RG12: Separate planned, implemented and evidenced-effective mitigation.
principles.RG13: Require applicable evidence after a material event.
principles.RG14: Map research residual status only to canonical research points.
principles.RG15: Assess uncertainty using accepted scenarios and observed variability.
principles.RG16: Recompute one-variable sensitivities without changing prior models.
principles.RG17: Identify shared dependencies and enforce maximum prerequisites.
principles.RG18: Reuse RV01–RV06 and RB01–RB05 with at most one revision.
principles.RG19: Resolve numeric zero, genuine N/R and qualified carry separately.
principles.RG20: Preserve research-only authority and stop after isolated assessment.
